title: Addition and subtraction of integers
competency: Find the sum and the difference of integers.

keywords.def: A number being added. In a + b = c, a and b are addends.
The answer to an addition. In a + b = c, c is the sum.
The size of a number without its sign. The magnitude of −43 is 43.
Taking away. a − b is the same as a + (−b).
Changing the order does not change the answer: m + n = n + m.

en.text: To add on a number line, start at the first number. Move right for a positive second number and left for a negative one. Where you stop is the sum. Two opposites add to zero.

screens.ask: Tap Hop twice. Where do you land?
screens.after: Start at 4, move 8 to the left. You land on −4. So 4 + (−8) = −4.

screens.title: Rules: addition on a number line
paras: 1. Start the arrow at the first addend.
2. If the second addend is positive, move right by its size.
3. If it is negative, move left by its size.
4. The sum is where the arrow ends.
screens.note: In a + b = c, a and b are addends and c is the sum.

screens.after: Start at −3, move 6 to the right. You land on 3.

screens.title: Note
paras: The sum of any two opposite integers is zero.

screens.ask: Tap Hop twice. Where do opposites land?
screens.after:
Start at 6, move 6 to the left. You land on 0.
So 6 + (−6) = 0.

screens.ask: Add on the number line: where does −3 + (−4) land? Tap it.
screens.why:
Start at the first addend, −3.
The second addend, −4, is negative: move 4 to the left.
−4, −5, −6, −7.
So −3 + (−4) = −7.
screens.clue: The second number is negative. Which way do you move?

screens.why:
Start at −7.
The second addend, 4, is positive: move 4 to the right.
−6, −5, −4, −3.
So −7 + 4 = −3.

−10 and 10 are opposite numbers.
Start at −10 and move 10 to the right.
You land exactly on 0.
The sum of two opposite integers is 0.
screens.clue: What do opposites add up to?

screens.why:
Think on the number line: start at ___, move 6 to the left, land on −2.
Undo the move: from −2 go 6 to the right.
−2 + 6 = 4.
Check: 4 + (−6) = −2. ✓
screens.clue: Undo the move: go 6 to the right from −2.

en.text: For different signs, take the sign of the number with the bigger magnitude, then subtract the magnitudes. For two negatives, add the magnitudes and keep the minus sign. Addition is commutative and associative, adding zero changes nothing, and opposites add to zero.

screens.title: Profit or loss?
screens.ask: Hussen lost Birr 15, then made a profit of Birr 17. Overall he has
screens.after:
A loss is negative: −15. A profit is positive: +17.
−15 + 17: the profit is bigger by 17 − 15 = 2.
So overall he has a profit of Birr 2.
A loss of Birr 32 would mean two losses added: −15 + (−17).

screens.ask: Tap Hop twice: first the loss, then the profit.
screens.after:
From −15, move 17 to the right. You pass 0 and land on 2.
The bigger move (17) wins, so the sign is +.
17 − 15 = 2. So −15 + 17 = 2.

screens.title: Different signs
paras: Step 1: Take the sign of the number with the greater magnitude.
Step 2: Find the difference of the magnitudes.
Step 3: Put the sign in front of the difference.

screens.title: Two negative integers
paras: Step 1: The sign of the sum is always negative.
Step 3: Put the negative sign in front.

screens.title: Properties of addition
screens.ask: Tap each property to see an example.
items: The sum of two integers is an integer: 4 + (−6) = −2.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The size of a number without its sign.
Changing the order does not change the answer.

screens.why:
The signs are different: +625 and −214.
Step 1: the bigger magnitude is 625, and it is positive. So the sum is positive.
Step 2: subtract the magnitudes: 625 − 214 = 411.
So 625 + (−214) = 411.
screens.clue: Which magnitude is bigger? Take its sign.

screens.why:
The signs are different: −325 and +234.
Step 1: the bigger magnitude is 325, and it is negative. So the sum is negative.
Step 2: subtract the magnitudes: 325 − 234 = 91.
So −325 + 234 = −91.
screens.clue: Take the sign of the bigger magnitude.

screens.why:
Both addends are negative.
Step 1: the sum of two negatives is negative.
Step 2: add the magnitudes: 20 + 10 = 30.
So −20 + (−10) = −30.

screens.ask: Debt as integers: you owe Birr 5. You borrow Birr 12 more. Your total debt as an integer is ___
screens.why:
Owing money is negative: −5.
Borrowing Birr 12 more adds another −12.
−5 + (−12): both negative, so the sum is negative.
5 + 12 = 17. Total debt: −17.

m + n = n + m: the order changes. That is the commutative property.
x + (y + z) = (x + y) + z: the brackets move. That is associative.
x + 0 = x: adding 0 changes nothing. Property of zero.
x + (−x) = 0: a number plus its opposite. Property of opposites.
screens.clue: Order changes: commutative. Brackets move: associative.
screens.text: Properties of addition: match each rule with its name.

screens.why:
Add two numbers at a time.
Step 1: −560 + (−50): both negative, 560 + 50 = 610. So −610.
Step 2: −610 + 210: different signs. 610 > 210 and 610 is negative.
Step 3: 610 − 210 = 400. So the answer is −400.
screens.clue: Add two numbers at a time.

en.text: Subtracting an integer is the same as adding its opposite: a minus b equals a plus minus b. So 4 minus 7 is 4 plus minus 7, which is minus 3. Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding a positive one: 25 minus minus 30 is 55.

screens.title: Turn it into a sum
screens.after:
Subtracting 6 is the same as adding the opposite of 6, which is −6.
So 3 − 6 = 3 + (−6).
On the number line: start at 3, move 6 left, land on −3.
3 + 6 = 9 and 6 − 3 = 3 give different answers.

screens.title: Definition: subtraction
paras: Subtracting b from a is the same as adding the opposite of b to a.
For any integers a and b: a − b = a + (−b).

screens.ask: Tap Hop twice. Subtracting 6 is a move of 6 to the left.
screens.after:
Start at 3, move 6 to the left. You land on −3.
So 3 − 6 = 3 + (−6) = −3.

screens.title: Key words
defs: a − b is the same as a + (−b).

screens.why:
Subtracting a number means adding its opposite.
The opposite of −30 is 30.
So 25 − (−30) = 25 + 30.
25 + 30 = 55.
screens.clue: Subtracting a negative is adding a positive.

screens.why:
Change the subtraction into an addition: 4 − 7 = 4 + (−7).
Different signs: 7 > 4 and 7 is negative, so the answer is negative.
7 − 4 = 3.
So 4 − 7 = −3.

Change to an addition: −75 − 15 = −75 + (−15).
Both are negative, so the sum is negative.
75 + 15 = 90.
So −75 − 15 = −90.

Subtracting −1000 means adding 1000: −1789 + 1000.
Different signs: 1789 > 1000 and 1789 is negative, so the answer is negative.
1789 − 1000 = 789.
So −1789 − (−1000) = −789.

screens.ask: Temperature difference: a cold night is −109 °F and a hot day is 109 °F. How many degrees warmer is the day? ___
screens.why:
Difference = higher − lower = 109 − (−109).
Subtracting −109 means adding 109.
109 + 109 = 218.
So the day is 218 °F warmer. (From −109 up to 0 is 109; from 0 up to 109 is 109 more.)
screens.clue: Subtract the lower from the higher.
Work left to right, two numbers at a time.

screens.title: Signs
steps: Numbers below zero get a minus sign: 5 °C below zero is −5.
Numbers above zero are positive: +5 or just 5.
On a number line, negatives are left of 0.

screens.text: Write the temperature with a sign: 3 °C below zero is written
screens.why:
Below zero means less than 0.
Numbers less than 0 get a minus sign.
So 3 °C below zero is −3.

They are the same distance from 0, on different sides.
The sum of two opposites is 0.

Start at −3.
7 is positive: move 7 to the right.
−2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
So −3 + 7 = 4.

The bigger magnitude is 23, and it is positive: the sum is positive.
23 − 10 = 13.
So 23 + (−10) = 13.

items.why:

The bigger magnitude is 40, and it is positive: the sum is positive.
40 − 30 = 10.
So −30 + 40 = 10.

Two at a time.
Step 1: −50 + (−45): both negative, 50 + 45 = 95. So −95.
Step 2: −95 + 62: 95 > 62 and 95 is negative, so the sum is negative.

The bigger magnitude is 23, and it is negative: the sum is negative.
23 − 12 = 11.
So 12 + (−23) = −11.

items.ask: Integers in real life: a plane climbs 2500 m, then descends 150 m. Its height is ___ m
items.why:
Climbing is positive: +2500.
Descending is negative: −150.
2500 + (−150): 2500 is bigger and positive, so the answer is positive.
2500 − 150 = 2350 m.

items.text: Subtraction as addition: write 3 − (−10) as a sum.
items.why:
a − b = a + (−b): add the opposite.
The opposite of −10 is 10.
So 3 − (−10) = 3 + 10.
3 + (−10) keeps the wrong sign.

items.text: Subtraction as addition: write 9 − 12 as a sum.
items.why:
a − b = a + (−b): add the opposite.
The opposite of 12 is −12.
So 9 − 12 = 9 + (−12).
9 + 12 adds instead of subtracts.

Add the opposite: 0 − 3 = 0 + (−3).
Adding to 0 changes nothing.
So 0 − 3 = −3.

Add the opposite: 25 − 75 = 25 + (−75).
Different signs: 75 > 25 and 75 is negative, so the answer is negative.
75 − 25 = 50.
So 25 − 75 = −50.

test.why:
Different signs: −9 and +5.
The bigger magnitude is 9, and it is negative: the sum is negative.
9 − 5 = 4.
So −9 + 5 = −4.

Both addends are negative, so the sum is negative.
Add the magnitudes: 36 + 40 = 76.
So −36 + (−40) = −76.

Add the opposite: −248 − 125 = −248 + (−125).
Both are negative, so the answer is negative.
248 + 125 = 373.
So −248 − 125 = −373.

test.ask: Integers in real life: a submarine is at −21 m. It moves up 6 m, then down 10 m. Its depth is now ___ m
test.why:
Up is positive, down is negative.
Step 1: −21 + 6: 21 > 6 and 21 is negative. 21 − 6 = 15. So −15.
Step 2: −15 + (−10): both negative. 15 + 10 = 25. So −25.
The submarine is now at −25 m.
